items.title: Jerry Hey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 2, 2023
items.q: I went to Indiana University and studied with this William Adam trumpet teacher, just the greatest man I’ve ever met.

ctx.x: So what led you to believe that you could do that?

When — so I went to Indiana University and studied with this William Adam trumpet teacher, just the greatest man I’ve ever met. And nothing to do with trumpet, just a brilliant man in all aspects of life. And he kind of made you play trumpet for any occasion. You know you have to learn how to play trumpet before you can play the piccolo solo on “Penny Lane” or before you can play a jazz solo, or before you can play lead you’ve got to be able to play the trumpet. You know it’s about learning how to play the…

A bit of delicious irony, I was in a band, many bands in the ‘70s and so forth, and that was my job as well, to listen to the records, and some of the horn parts that I was transcribing were written by you.
